TrapWin Limiter @VERSION@ - Windows (VST3)
==========================================

Thank you for buying TrapWin Limiter!

REQUIREMENTS
  Windows 10 or 11, 64-bit, and a 64-bit VST3 host
  (FL Studio, Ableton Live, Cubase, Studio One, Reaper, Bitwig ...).

OPTION A - INSTALLER (recommended)
  1. Close your DAW.
  2. Run TrapWin_Limiter_v@VERSION@_Windows_Setup.exe and click through the steps.
     If Windows shows "Windows protected your PC", click "More info" > "Run anyway".
  3. Open your DAW and rescan plugins:
       FL Studio: Options > Manage plugins > Find installed plugins
       Ableton:   Preferences > Plug-ins > Rescan
       Reaper:    Options > Preferences > Plug-ins > VST > Re-scan

OPTION B - MANUAL INSTALL
  Copy the folder "Manual Install\TrapLimit.vst3" into
         C:\Program Files\Common Files\VST3\
  (Windows asks for administrator permission - click Continue), then rescan
  plugins in your DAW.

Find the plugin as "TrapWin Limiter" (vendor: TrapWin).

UNINSTALL
  Settings > Apps > TrapWin Limiter > Uninstall
  (manual install: delete C:\Program Files\Common Files\VST3\TrapLimit.vst3)
  Your own presets are in %APPDATA%\TrapVST\Limiter\Presets

User guide: "TrapWin Limiter - Manual.pdf"   License terms: EULA.txt

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
CESKY
  A) Spust TrapWin_Limiter_v@VERSION@_Windows_Setup.exe a proklikej instalaci.
  B) Nebo rucne: slozku "Manual Install\TrapLimit.vst3" zkopiruj do
     C:\Program Files\Common Files\VST3\
  Pak v DAW znovu vyhledej pluginy. Plugin najdes jako "TrapWin Limiter".
